footprint.symmetry: bilaterally symmetric across central front axis

raw_elements: stacked slab roof tiers (concentric rectangles with hollow center)
oak plank horizontal walls with stonebrick base and corner blocks
central recessed entrance/atrium with a short stair/ledge
stone slab window/awning bands across front
raw_hints: Footprint: rectangular core ~11x9 blocks with a 3x5 recessed central entrance cutout on the front face (visible from top view).
Walls: three horizontal bands — bottom 1 layer stonebrick, middle 3 layers oak planks, top 1 layer stone slab/stonebrick trim; place stonebrick corner blocks one-high.
Roof: place progressively smaller stone slabs centered, each tier inset by 1 block from previous forming 5–6 tiers; leave central hollow / lightwell.
Front: add glowstone blocks inset on either side of the front at the seam between middle and top bands.
Surround: surround the building with a shallow dug perimeter of dirt-level lowered by 1 block (uncertain material).
rebuild_intent.summary: Small rectangular pavilion with stepped flat stone-slab roof tiers, oak plank walls framed by stonebrick at base and corners, glowstone accent lights on the front corners, and an indented central entrance/atrium visible from top. Roof consists of several concentric rectangular slabs stacked upward leaving a hollow center. Ground around building is dug out to a shallow moat of dirt/gravel (uncertain).
